```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(shiny)
library(flexdashboard)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)
library(httr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(hms)
library(DT)
library(reactable)
library(plotly)
library(creelutils)

# Hyperlinks. Built from pieces so copy/paste can't turn it into a markdown link
FISH_HOST       <- paste0("https", "://", "apps.wdfw-fish.us")
CREEL_EVENT_URL <- paste0(FISH_HOST, "/creel/creel_event/")

# Strip any "[url](url)" formatting, keep the plain URL
clean_url <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\[[^]]*\\]\\(([^)]*)\\)", "\\1", x)
  trimws(gsub("[][()\"'<> ]", "", x))
}

# Photo URLs: pull the first http(s) URL out of the text; keeps ( ) and other valid characters
photo_url <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("\\[[^]]*\\]\\(([^)]*)\\)", "\\1", x)   # markdown [text](url) -> url
  stringr::str_extract(x, "https?://[^\\s\"'<>]+")
}

# Open in the Windows default browser (not in R / RStudio)
open_external <- function(url) {
  url <- clean_url(url)
  stopifnot(startsWith(url, CREEL_EVENT_URL))
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") shell.exec(url) else utils::browseURL(url)
  invisible(NULL)
}

# Same, but for photo links (any http/https URL)
open_photo_external <- function(url) {
  url <- photo_url(url)
  stopifnot(!is.na(url), grepl("^https?://", url))
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") shell.exec(url) else utils::browseURL(url)
  invisible(NULL)
}

plotly_dark_theme <- list(
  plot_bgcolor = "#222222",
  paper_bgcolor = "#222222",
  font = list(color = "#ffffff"),
  xaxis = list(gridcolor = "#444444", linecolor = "#666666"),
  yaxis = list(gridcolor = "#444444", linecolor = "#666666")
)

theme_dark_custom <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA),
      text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#333333", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "#ffffff"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#444444"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#333333"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#222222", color = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_dark_custom())
```

```{r database-connection, include=FALSE}
con <- connect_creel_db()

shiny::onStop(function() try(DBI::dbDisconnect(con), silent = TRUE))

available_fisheries <- tryCatch({
  lut <- fishery_lut(conn = con)
  if ("year" %in% names(lut)) lut <- dplyr::arrange(lut, dplyr::desc(year), fishery_name)
  unique(as.character(lut$fishery_name))
}, error = function(e) {
  creelutils::fetch_fishery_names()
})
available_fisheries <- available_fisheries[!is.na(available_fisheries) & nzchar(available_fisheries)]

q_in <- function(col, x) {
  x <- unique(as.character(x))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return("FALSE")
  sprintf("%s %%in%% c(%s)", col, paste(encodeString(x, quote = '"'), collapse = ", "))
}

prev_fishery_name <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(f) {
    if (str_detect(f, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}")) {
      y <- as.integer(str_match(f, "(\\d{4})-\\d{2}")[, 2])
      str_replace(f, "\\d{4}-\\d{2}", sprintf("%d-%02d", y - 1L, y %% 100L))
    } else if (str_detect(f, "\\d{4}")) {
      y <- as.integer(str_extract(f, "\\d{4}"))
      str_replace(f, "\\d{4}", as.character(y - 1L))
    } else NA_character_
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

```{r data-wrangling, include=FALSE}
# Only *_date and *_time columns are converted; qaqc_datetime is left untouched
process_datetime <- function(df) {
  to_date <- function(x) {
    if (inherits(x, "Date")) {
      x
    } else if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
      as.Date(x)
    } else {
      ymd(as.character(x))
    }
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      across(matches("_date$"), to_date),
      across(matches("_time$"), as_hms)
    )
}

# Make sure optional columns exist (as NA text) so select() never fails
ensure_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  for (nm in cols) if (!nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  df
}

wrangle_catch <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    ensure_cols(c("comments", "image_url")) %>%
    select(
      event_date, water_body, fishery_name, project_name,
      species, run, sex, fate, fork_length_cm, fish_count,
      life_stage, fish_processing_status, fin_mark, cwt_detection_status,
      snout_code, cwt_read_status, cwt_code, cwt_species, cwt_run,
      scale_card_num, scale_card_pos, scale_age_code,
      pit_detection_status, comments, image_url,
      creel_event_id, interview_id, catch_id
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      fish_count     = as.numeric(fish_count),
      fork_length_cm = as.numeric(fork_length_cm),
      # Stray spaces (e.g. "Kept ") would make exact matches fail
      species        = trimws(as.character(species)),
      fate           = trimws(as.character(fate))
    ) %>%
    process_datetime()
}

# Accepts either comment_txt or comments_txt; exposes it as comment_txt
wrangle_creel_event <- function(df) {
  df <- df %>% rename(water_body = water_body_desc)
  if (!"comment_txt" %in% names(df)) {
    df$comment_txt <- if ("comments_txt" %in% names(df)) df$comments_txt else NA_character_
  }
  df %>%
    select(
      event_date, water_body, project_name, start_time, end_time,
      tie_in_indicator, comment_txt, qaqc_datetime, creel_event_id
    ) %>%
    mutate(tie_in_indicator = as.numeric(tie_in_indicator)) %>%
    process_datetime()
}

wrangle_interview <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    ensure_cols("comment_txt") %>%
    select(
      event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body, crc_area, fishing_location,
      section_num, survey_type, surveyor_num, interview_number, trip_status,
      previously_interviewed, angler_count, total_group_count, vehicle_count,
      trailer_count, boat_type, boat_used, fishing_start_time, fishing_end_time,
      interview_time, comment_txt, creel_event_id, interview_id, location_id
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(c(interview_number, total_group_count, vehicle_count,
                    trailer_count, angler_count), as.numeric)) %>%
    process_datetime()
}

wrangle_effort <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(
      event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body, location,
      tie_in_indicator, survey_type, count_sequence, section_num,
      effort_start_time, effort_end_time, count_quantity, count_type,
      location_type, surveyor_num, comments, p_census_boat, p_census_bank,
      indirect_census_bank, no_count_reason, creel_event_id, effort_event_id,
      location_id
    ) %>%
    arrange(event_date, fishery_name, water_body, location,
            tie_in_indicator, count_sequence, section_num, effort_start_time) %>%
    mutate(across(c(count_quantity, p_census_boat, p_census_bank,
                    indirect_census_bank), as.numeric)) %>%
    process_datetime()
}

sel_fisheries <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(input$fishery_go, {
  req(input$fishery_pick)
  sel_fisheries(input$fishery_pick)
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

# Hyperlink click -> default browser
observeEvent(input$open_url, {
  req(is.character(input$open_url), length(input$open_url) == 1)
  tryCatch(
    open_external(input$open_url),
    error = function(e) showNotification(
      paste("Could not open link:", conditionMessage(e)), type = "error", duration = 10)
  )
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

# Photo click -> default browser
observeEvent(input$open_photo, {
  req(is.character(input$open_photo), length(input$open_photo) == 1)
  tryCatch(
    open_photo_external(input$open_photo),
    error = function(e) showNotification(
      paste("Could not open photo link:", conditionMessage(e)), type = "error", duration = 10)
  )
}, ignoreInit = TRUE)

dat <- reactive({
  fs <- req(sel_fisheries())
  withProgress(message = "Querying selected fisheries...", value = 0.1, {
    flt <- q_in("fishery_name", fs)

    catch     <- fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_analysis_catch", filter = flt)
    incProgress(0.25)
    interview <- fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_analysis_interview", filter = flt)
    incProgress(0.25)
    effort    <- fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_analysis_effort_count", filter = flt)
    incProgress(0.2)

    ids <- unique(na.omit(as.character(c(
      catch$creel_event_id, effort$creel_event_id, interview$creel_event_id
    ))))

    creel_event <- if (length(ids)) {
      split(ids, ceiling(seq_along(ids) / 1000)) %>%
        map(~fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_creel_event",
                            filter = q_in("creel_event_id", .x))) %>%
        bind_rows()
    } else {
      fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_creel_event", filter = "FALSE")
    }

    list(
      catch       = wrangle_catch(catch),
      interview   = wrangle_interview(interview),
      effort      = wrangle_effort(effort),
      creel_event = wrangle_creel_event(creel_event)
    )
  })
})

wdfw_catch        <- reactive(dat()$catch)
wdfw_interview    <- reactive(dat()$interview)
wdfw_effort_count <- reactive(dat()$effort)
wdfw_creel_event  <- reactive(dat()$creel_event)

prev_map <- reactive({
  tibble(fishery_name = req(sel_fisheries())) %>%
    mutate(prev_name = prev_fishery_name(fishery_name),
           prev_name = if_else(prev_name %in% available_fisheries, prev_name, NA_character_))
})

prev_catch <- reactive({
  pn <- na.omit(prev_map()$prev_name)
  if (!length(pn)) return(NULL)
  wrangle_catch(fetch_db_table(con, "creel", "vw_analysis_catch",
                               filter = q_in("fishery_name", pn)))
})
```

```{r qa-checks, include=FALSE}
# Each QA check is defined once here and used by both its page and the summary page.

stat_mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# Turn "" into NA in text columns (safe for Date/time columns)
blank_to_na <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~na_if(trimws(.x), "")))
}

# TRUE when a value has non-blank text
has_text <- function(x) !is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x)))

# count_type values used by the effort checks (exact spelling from the database)
veh_types    <- c("Vehicles", "Vehicle Only")
trl_types    <- c("Trailers", "Trailers Only")
effort_types <- c(veh_types, trl_types)   # use veh_types in qa_eff_veh15 to flag vehicle rows only

gt10_species <- c("Coho", "Chinook", "Steelhead", "Chum", "Sockeye",

    select(event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           cwt_detection_status, snout_code, species,

    filter(CWT_Neg_with_SnoutCode == "CWT no (Beep) with snout code")
})

# Vectorised (no rowwise) so it also works when zero fish match
qa_rel_bio <- reactive({
  blank_to_na(wdfw_catch()) %>%
    mutate(
      has_cwt   = cwt_detection_status %in% c("CWT - (No Beep)", "CWT + (Beep)"),
      has_card  = !is.na(scale_card_num),
      has_pos   = !is.na(scale_card_pos),
      has_snout = !is.na(snout_code)
    ) %>%
    filter(fate %in% "Released", has_cwt | has_card | has_pos | has_snout) %>%
    mutate(
      bio_flag = paste0(
        if_else(has_cwt,   paste0("; ", cwt_detection_status), ""),
        if_else(has_card,  "; scale card #",                   ""),
        if_else(has_pos,   "; scale card position",            ""),
        if_else(has_snout, "; snout code",                     "")
      ),
      bio_flag = sub("^; ", "", bio_flag)
    ) %>%
    select(event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           species, fin_mark, fate, cwt_detection_status,
           scale_card_num, scale_card_pos, snout_code,
           creel_event_id, bio_flag)
})

# Catch > 10 (info) - listed species only
qa_catch_gt10 <- reactive({
  wdfw_catch() %>%
    filter(!is.na(fish_count), fish_count > 10, species %in% gt10_species) %>%
    mutate(catch_alert = "Catch > 10") %>%
    select(catch_alert, event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           species, run, fate, fish_count, creel_event_id, interview_id, catch_id)
})

# Scale card errors (review). One check, with an error description per row.
# Rules per scale_card_num: 5 digits; one species; positions exactly 1..n
# (no duplicates, no gaps). Positions with no card number are also flagged.
qa_scale_card <- reactive({
  d <- blank_to_na(wdfw_catch()) %>%
    mutate(card    = as.character(scale_card_num),
           pos_txt = as.character(scale_card_pos),
           pos     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pos_txt)),
           sp      = as.character(species)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(card) | !is.na(pos_txt))

  bad_cards <- d %>%
    filter(!is.na(card)) %>%
    group_by(card) %>%
    mutate(
      e_digits = !grepl("^[0-9]{5}$", card),
      e_spp    = anyNA(sp) || n_distinct(sp) != 1,
      e_seq    = anyNA(pos) || !all(sort(pos) == seq_len(n())),
      species_on_card   = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(sp))), collapse = " / "),
      positions_on_card = paste(sort(pos), collapse = ",")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(e_digits | e_spp | e_seq) %>%
    mutate(scale_card_error = sub("; $", "", paste0(
      if_else(e_digits, "Card # not 5 digits; ", ""),
      if_else(e_spp,    "Mixed or missing species; ", ""),
      if_else(e_seq,    "Positions not 1..n without gaps/duplicates; ", ""))))

  orphans <- d %>%
    filter(is.na(card)) %>%
    mutate(scale_card_error = "Position with no card #",
           species_on_card = NA_character_, positions_on_card = NA_character_)

  bind_rows(bad_cards, orphans) %>%
    arrange(card, pos) %>%
    select(scale_card_error, scale_card_num, scale_card_pos, species,
           species_on_card, positions_on_card,
           event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           creel_event_id, interview_id, catch_id)
})

# ---- Effort ----
qa_eff_1 <- reactive({
  wdfw_effort_count() %>%
    filter(tie_in_indicator == FALSE) %>%
    group_by(project_name, fishery_name, section_num, event_date, creel_event_id, location) %>%
    summarise(max_cs = max(count_sequence, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(fishery_name, section_num, event_date, creel_event_id) %>%
    mutate(mode_max_cs = stat_mode(max_cs)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(max_cs < mode_max_cs) %>%
    mutate(effort_qc_2 = "effort count sequence error") %>%
    select(event_date, project_name, fishery_name, section_num,
           location, max_cs, mode_max_cs, creel_event_id, effort_qc_2)
})

  wdfw_effort_count() %>%
    filter(count_type %in% effort_types,
           !is.na(count_quantity), count_quantity > 15) %>%
    mutate(effort_alert = "Vehicles >15") %>%
    select(effort_alert, event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           location, survey_type, count_sequence, count_type, count_quantity,
           creel_event_id, effort_event_id)
})

# More trailers than vehicles within an effort_event_id (info)
qa_eff_trl <- reactive({
  wdfw_effort_count() %>%
    filter(count_type %in% effort_types, !is.na(effort_event_id)) %>%
    group_by(effort_event_id) %>%
    summarise(
      event_date     = first(event_date),
      project_name   = first(project_name),
      fishery_name   = first(fishery_name),
      water_body     = first(water_body),
      location       = first(location),
      count_sequence = first(count_sequence),
      creel_event_id = first(creel_event_id),
      vehicles = sum(count_quantity[count_type %in% veh_types], na.rm = TRUE),
      trailers = sum(count_quantity[count_type %in% trl_types], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(trailers > vehicles) %>%
    mutate(effort_alert = "More trailers than vehicles") %>%
    select(effort_alert, event_date, project_name, fishery_name, water_body,
           location, count_sequence, vehicles, trailers,
           creel_event_id, effort_event_id)
})

qa_summary <- reactive({
  shiny::validate(shiny::need(!is.null(sel_fisheries()),
                              "Pick fishery(s) and click Load data."))
  map_dfr(qa_checks, function(x) {
    res <- tryCatch(x$data(), error = function(e) NULL)
    tibble(
      group  = x$group,
      type   = x$type,
      check  = x$name,
      page   = x$page,
      issues = if (is.null(res)) NA_integer_ else nrow(res),
      events = if (is.null(res) || !"creel_event_id" %in% names(res)) NA_integer_
               else n_distinct(na.omit(res$creel_event_id))
    )
  }) %>%
    arrange(type == "info",                          # review checks first, info last
            desc(replace_na(issues, -1L) > 0),       # flagged first
            desc(issues), group, check)
})
```

```{r plotting-functions, include=FALSE}
latest_date <- function(df) {
  d <- df$event_date
  if (!length(d) || all(is.na(d))) return(today())
  max(d, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Keep only the last `days_back` days of each fishery, measured from THAT fishery's
# own latest date (so a fishery with later dates can't push another one out of the window)
recent_by_fishery <- function(df, days_back) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(event_date)) %>%
    group_by(fishery_name) %>%
    filter(event_date >= max(event_date, na.rm = TRUE) - days(days_back)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

daily_x <- function() list(
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%m/%d", expand = expansion(add = 1)),
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 7))
)

scroll_box <- function(...) {
  div(style = "height: calc(100vh - 150px); overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;", ...)
}

tall_height <- function(n_rows, per = 320, base = 160) max(650, base + per * n_rows)

create_catch_plot <- function(data, title_text = "", facet_var = NULL) {
  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = event_date, y = species, color = fate)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Kept" = "#ff6b6b", "Released" = "#4ecdc4")) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0.1) +
    theme_dark_custom() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, colour = NULL, subtitle = title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10)
    ) + daily_x()
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)))
  ggplotly(p) %>% layout(plotly_dark_theme)
}

# Fixed bar width (0.8 day) so sparse dates don't produce bars spanning several days
create_bar_plot <- function(data, title_text = "", facet_var = NULL) {
  p <- data %>%
    mutate(fate = factor(fate, levels = c("Kept", "Released"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = event_date, y = total_catch, fill = fate)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Kept" = "#ff6b6b", "Released" = "#4ecdc4")) +
    theme_dark_custom() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Total Catch", fill = NULL, subtitle = title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "italic", hjust = 0.5, size = 8),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
    ) + daily_x()
  if (!is.null(facet_var)) p <- p + facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", facet_var)))
  ggplotly(p) %>% layout(plotly_dark_theme)
}

# Monthly bubbles: months on x, species on y, rivers as rows, prev vs current as columns
create_comparison_plot <- function(cur, prev, fishery, prev_name) {
  if (length(prev_name) != 1L) prev_name <- NA_character_
  periods <- unique(na.omit(c(prev_name, fishery)))

  d <- bind_rows(cur, prev) %>%
    filter(fishery_name %in% periods, fate %in% c("Kept", "Released"),
           species %in% focal_species, !is.na(event_date)) %>%
    mutate(water_body = replace_na(na_if(as.character(water_body), ""), "Not recorded"),
           period     = factor(fishery_name, levels = periods),
           month_num  = month(event_date))
  shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, paste("No recorded catch for", fishery)))

  start_m  <- month(min(d$event_date))
  m_levels <- month.abb[((start_m - 1 + 0:11) %% 12) + 1]

  d <- d %>%
    group_by(water_body, period, month_num, species, fate) %>%
    summarise(total_count = sum(fish_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(total_count > 0) %>%
    mutate(
      month_label = factor(month.abb[month_num], levels = m_levels),
      hover = paste0(
        "Fishery: ", period,
        "<br>River: ", water_body,
        "<br>Month: ", month.name[month_num],
        "<br>Species: ", species,
        "<br>Fate: ", fate,
        "<br>Fish: ", format(total_count, big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
  shiny::validate(shiny::need(nrow(d) > 0, paste("No recorded catch for", fishery)))

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(month_label, species, size = total_count, color = fate, text = hover)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.75, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Kept" = "#ff6b6b", "Released" = "#4ecdc4")) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 14, name = "Monthly count") +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    facet_grid(water_body ~ period) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, color = NULL,
         subtitle = if (is.na(prev_name)) paste0(fishery, " (no previous-year fishery found)")
                    else paste0(prev_name, " vs ", fishery)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10))

  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(plotly_dark_theme, margin = list(l = 80, r = 100, b = 70, t = 60))
}

# creel_event_id -> clickable link; image_url -> clickable "View photo" link.
# Clicks are sent to R, which opens the default browser.
# sort = FALSE keeps the check's own row order (used by Scale card errors).
qaqc_prep <- function(df, sort = TRUE) {
  if (sort && "event_date" %in% names(df)) df <- df %>% arrange(desc(event_date), desc(creel_event_id))
  if ("creel_event_id" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(creel_event_id = as.character(creel_event_id),
      creel_event_id = if_else(is.na(creel_event_id), NA_character_,
        sprintf('<a href="#" class="creel-link" data-url="%s%s" style="color:#64b5f6; text-decoration:underline;">%s</a>',
                CREEL_EVENT_URL, creel_event_id, creel_event_id)))
  }
  if ("image_url" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% mutate(image_url = photo_url(image_url),
      image_url = if_else(is.na(image_url), NA_character_,
        sprintf('<a href="#" class="photo-link" data-url="%s" style="color:#64b5f6; text-decoration:underline;">View photo</a>',
                htmltools::htmlEscape(image_url, attribute = TRUE))))
  }
  df
}

dt_dark <- function(data, sort = TRUE) {
  data <- qaqc_prep(data, sort = sort)
  # Only the link columns are left unescaped; comments and other text stay escaped
  html_cols <- c("creel_event_id", "image_url")
  esc <- if (any(names(data) %in% html_cols)) {
    which(!names(data) %in% html_cols)
  } else TRUE
  datatable(
    data,
    filter = 'top',
    escape = esc,
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Brtip',
      pageLength = 50,
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv'),
      order = list(),
      language = list(emptyTable = "No issues found for the selected fisheries"),
      initComplete = JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "$('body').css({'background-color': '#222222', 'color': '#ffffff'});",
        "$('.dataTables_wrapper').css({'background-color': '#222222', 'color': '#ffffff'});",
        "}"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    formatStyle(columns = 1:ncol(data), backgroundColor = '#222222', color = '#ffffff')
}

dark_reactable_theme <- reactableTheme(
  color = "#ffffff", backgroundColor = "#222222", borderColor = "#444444",
  stripedColor = "#2a2a2a", highlightColor = "#333333",
  inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#333333", color = "#ffffff"),
  selectStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#333333", color = "#ffffff"),
  paginationStyle = list(color = "#ffffff", fontSize = "15px", padding = "10px",
                         borderTop = "1px solid #666666"),
  pageButtonStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#3b3b3b", color = "#ffffff",
                         border = "1px solid #888888", minWidth = "38px", padding = "6px 10px"),
  pageButtonHoverStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#555555"),
  pageButtonCurrentStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#375a7f", fontWeight = "bold")
)
```

```{r qa-summary-page, echo=FALSE}
renderUI({
  s <- qa_summary()
  r <- s %>% filter(type == "review")
  flagged <- sum(r$issues > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  errors  <- sum(is.na(s$issues))
  div(style = "padding: 6px 4px 12px 4px; font-size: 16px;",
      tags$b(sprintf("%d of %d checks need review", flagged, nrow(r))),
      sprintf(" · %s total issues", format(sum(r$issues, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = ",")),
      if (errors > 0) tags$span(style = "color:#bbbbbb;",
                                sprintf(" · %d check(s) failed to run", errors)),
      tags$div(style = "font-size: 13px; color:#bbbbbb; margin-top: 4px;",
               "Click a row to open that check. Blue = info only (not counted as issues)."))
})

renderReactable({
  s <- qa_summary()
  reactable(
    s,
    filterable = TRUE, outlined = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, resizable = TRUE,
    pagination = FALSE,
    theme = dark_reactable_theme,
    rowStyle = list(cursor = "pointer"),
    onClick = JS("function(rowInfo) { window.fishcheckGoTo(rowInfo.row.page); }"),
    columns = list(
      group  = colDef(name = "Group", minWidth = 110),
      check  = colDef(name = "Check", minWidth = 280),
      type   = colDef(show = FALSE),
      page   = colDef(show = FALSE),
      issues = colDef(
        name = "Count", align = "center", maxWidth = 110,
        cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "error" else format(v, big.mark = ","),
        style = function(v, index) {
          bg <- if (is.na(v)) "#666666"
                else if (s$type[index] == "info") "#375a7f"
                else if (v == 0) "#2e7d32"
                else "#c62828"
          list(background = bg, color = "#ffffff", fontWeight = "bold")
        }
      ),
      events = colDef(
        name = "Creel events", align = "center", maxWidth = 130,
        cell = function(v) if (is.na(v)) "" else format(v, big.mark = ",")
      )
    )
  )
})
```

```{r catch-by-river-total, echo=FALSE}
    filter(fate %in% c("Kept", "Released"), species %in% focal_species, !is.na(fish_count)) %>%
    group_by(water_body, species, fate) %>%
    summarise(total_catch = sum(fish_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    ggplot(aes(total_catch, species, fill = fate)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, NA)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Kept" = "#ff6b6b", "Released" = "#4ecdc4")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = NULL, subtitle = "Total recorded catch by river") +
    facet_wrap(~ water_body)
  ggplotly(p) %>% layout(plotly_dark_theme)
})
```

# Current vs Previous Year {data-navmenu="Raw Catch Plots"}

```{r current-vs-previous, echo=FALSE}
output$cvp_controls <- renderUI(
  selectInput("cvp_fishery", "Fishery:", choices = req(sel_fisheries()))
)

cvp_data <- reactive({
  fn <- req(input$cvp_fishery)
  req(fn %in% sel_fisheries())
  pm <- prev_map()
  pn <- pm$prev_name[match(fn, pm$fishery_name)]
  cur <- wdfw_catch() %>% filter(fishery_name == fn)
  prv <- if (!is.na(pn) && !is.null(prev_catch())) prev_catch() %>% filter(fishery_name == pn) else NULL
  list(cur = cur, prv = prv, fn = fn, pn = pn)
})

output$cvp_container <- renderUI({
  x <- cvp_data()
  n <- n_distinct(na.omit(bind_rows(x$cur, x$prv)$water_body))
  scroll_box(plotlyOutput("cvp_plot", height = paste0(tall_height(n), "px")))
})

output$cvp_plot <- renderPlotly({
  x <- cvp_data()
  create_comparison_plot(x$cur, x$prv, x$fn, x$pn)
})

uiOutput("cvp_controls")
uiOutput("cvp_container")
```

# Catch Table {data-navmenu="Summary"}

```{r catch-summary, echo=FALSE}
catch_group_table <- function(df, fn) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(fishery_name == fn) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(species, life_stage, fin_mark, fate), ~na_if(as.character(.x), "")),
      across(c(species, life_stage, fin_mark, fate), ~replace_na(.x, "Not recorded")),
      cwt_detection_status = replace_na(na_if(as.character(cwt_detection_status), ""),
                                        "Not recorded")
    )

  cwt <- d %>%
    group_by(species, life_stage, fin_mark, fate, cwt_detection_status) %>%
    summarise(fish = sum(fish_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(catch_group = paste(species, life_stage, fin_mark, fate, sep = "_"))

  grp <- cwt %>%
    group_by(catch_group) %>%
    summarise(
      total_fish   = sum(fish),
      n_cwt_status = n(),
      cwt_status   = if (n() == 1) first(cwt_detection_status)
                     else paste0(n(), " statuses (click row to expand)"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(catch_group)

  reactable(
    grp,
    filterable = TRUE,
    outlined = TRUE, highlight = TRUE, resizable = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 50, showPagination = TRUE, paginationType = "jump",
    columns = list(
      catch_group  = colDef(name = "Catch groups", minWidth = 220),
      total_fish   = colDef(name = "Total fish", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE)),
      cwt_status   = colDef(name = "CWT detection status"),
      n_cwt_status = colDef(show = FALSE)
    ),
    details = function(index) {
      if (grp$n_cwt_status[index] < 2) return(NULL)
      sub <- cwt %>%
        filter(catch_group == grp$catch_group[index]) %>%
        select(`CWT detection status` = cwt_detection_status, Fish = fish) %>%
        arrange(desc(Fish))
      div(style = "padding: 8px 24px;",
          reactable(sub, defaultPageSize = 50, outlined = TRUE, compact = TRUE,
                    theme = dark_reactable_theme))
    },
    theme = dark_reactable_theme
  )
}

renderUI(selectInput("catch_tbl_fishery", "Fishery:", choices = req(sel_fisheries())))
renderReactable(catch_group_table(wdfw_catch(), req(input$catch_tbl_fishery)))
```
